Senior Software Engineer - Core Experience, Growth

Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Growth Lifecycle Incentives team builds coupon experiences, one of the company’s core revenue drivers. We own the end-to-end experience for coupon storing, serving, ranking, and merchandising in app, web and CRM, partnering closely with Product, Data Science and Machine Learning Engineers, Retailer Managers to deliver features that make the coupon more valuable and accessible. We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers to design and build backend services and user-facing experiences. 

You’ll join a team of 19 engineers operating in a fast-paced environment. If you thrive on tackling complex problems, balancing new feature work with retailer-driven requests and technical debt, and rolling up your sleeves to deliver impact, this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Design, build, and own backend services, APIs, and data integrations that power coupon merchandising.
  • Implement and iterate on experiments end-to-end—partnering with Product and Data Science to ideate, launch, measure, and refine A/B tests that move key metrics.
  • Identify and execute codebase and product optimizations that improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across distributed systems.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define roadmaps, success metrics, and guardrails; communicate tradeoffs clearly in a fast-paced, experiment-driven environment.
  • Uphold high engineering standards through code reviews, testing, documentation, and thoughtful architecture decisions that balance speed with quality.
  • Partner with frontend and mobile engineers to deliver cohesive, high-quality experiences across web, iOS, and Android.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend development.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and framework (e.g., Go, Python/Django or Flask/FastAPI, Java/Spring, Ruby/Rails, or Node.js/Express).
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating RESTful or gRPC APIs and microservices in production.
  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching/NoSQL stores (e.g., Redis, DynamoDB); ability to write and optimize SQL.
  • Experience collaborating with Product and Data Science to build data-informed features and iterate based on experiment results.
  • Experience deploying and operating services on a public cloud (e.g., AWS, GCP) and working with containers (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) or similar orchestration.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable code; strong debugging skills; and solid testing practices (unit/integration).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with experimentation platforms and A/B testing frameworks, including experiment design, instrumentation, and analysis.
  • Frontend or mobile development experience (e.g., React/TypeScript, React Native, Swift, or Kotlin) and comfort collaborating across the stack.
  • Exposure to event-driven architectures and analytics tooling (e.g., Kafka or Pub/Sub, feature flag systems, Looker, Amplitude, or similar).
  • Experience with performance optimization and observability at scale (e.g., profiling, caching strategies, SLOs, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Comfort thriving in a fast-paced, experimentation-heavy environment with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and frequent learning cycles.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development and agentic coding workflows.
  • Domain experience in coupon or growth systems.

Voluntary Self ID Questionnaire (Canada)

At Instacart, we like to think of ourselves as a potluck—where everyone brings something new, different, and flavorful to the table. We believe our team’s wide range of perspectives, experiences and backgrounds enable us to build a better product for our customers. Instacart is for everyone, and we’re committed to fostering diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Individuals seeking employment at Instacart are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. 

Please note: If you apply for more than one job, you will be asked to fill out the questionnaire for each application.  

How is this information used?

In order to track our effectiveness in recruiting a wide range of talent and to ensure that we comply with reporting requirements, we invite all applicants to voluntarily provide demographic information in a confidential survey. Providing this information is entirely optional. It is only used to ensure our hiring efforts remain free of bias and for diversity monitoring purposes. Data collected is not factored into the hiring decision or thereafter and will not affect your opportunity for employment at Instacart.

Who has access to this data?

To ensure our hiring efforts are equitable, data is stored confidentially in our ATS (Applicant Tracking System) where only an Administrator can view demographic reporting. It is not accessible to hiring teams. Data is stored securely in a cloud-based data-warehouse to create anonymized dashboards that select HR leaders can reference.

Self-identification categories 

  • Gender Identity: How a person identifies their gender, regardless of their gender assigned at birth. 
  • 2SLGBTQIA+: An umbrella term for a range of sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions. Stands for "Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, Intersex, and Asexual. The plus sign is meant to encompass all other identities that belong to this community."
  • Race/Ethnicity: A person’s racial, ethnic or origin identity. 
  • Disability Status: A person’s physical or mental impairment which may limit one or more of their major life activities. Learn more here. 
  • Veteran Status: A person who has spent time serving in any branch of the military (retired or active).
